answer_1.quote: Text style transfer aims to convert the text into a target style while preserving the content of the source text, which has broad industrial applications such as computer-aided writing and advertising systems.
answer_1.outputs: generated text with transferred style while preserving content

answer_2.quote: Automatic evaluation metrics include the follows: ACC measures how accurately the model transfer the text style. BLEU compares the gold reference and transferred text to measure how well the non-stylistic text tokens are retained after being transferred from the original text. PPL is used to measure the fluency of the transferred text. G-mean is the geometric mean of BLEU and ACC.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation to more flexibly and comprehensively evaluate the models. ... Given the source style and source text, the annotators are asked to score the generated text in the range from 1 (Very Bad) to 5 (Very Good).
answer_4.guideline: Given the source style and source text, the annotators are asked to score the generated text in the range from 1 (Very Bad) to 5 (Very Good).
